# Generated from EU5 setup/countries, common/cultures and common/religions by tools/generate_eu5_selectors.js.
# Do not hand-edit generated selector entries; regenerate them after original database updates.

sakuya_selector_mark_country = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { NOT = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
		scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
	}
}

sakuya_selector_mark_culture = {
	scope = culture
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { NOT = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
		set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
		scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:ANI = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_country_select_ANJ = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:ANJ = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_country_clear_ANJ = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:ANJ = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	is_valid = { c:AUX = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:BIO = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:BQL = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { c:CBA = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }

			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

		}
	}

			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}

		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:HHB = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:HLM = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}
sakuya_selector_country_check_HLM = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:HLM = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_country_select_HLN = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:HLN = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:HTA = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}
sakuya_selector_country_check_HTA = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:HTA = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_country_select_HTK = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:HTK = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:JUL = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:KHN = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:KLW = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:KRT = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:LLS = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }

			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}

	is_valid = { c:MNS = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:MRB = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:MUT = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:PUK = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_country_select_PUR = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:PUR = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_country_clear_PUR = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:PUR = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	is_valid = { c:SMG = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:SOT = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { c:SSK = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:TBK = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { c:TES = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:TID = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:TNG = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:TRG = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:TVY = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:URB = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:WTG = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:XIU = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
	}
}
sakuya_selector_country_check_XIU = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { c:XIU = { has_variable = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_country_select_XIX = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }
		c:XIX = {
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		sakuya_selector_clear_country_marks = { player = scope:player_country }

			set_variable = { name = sakuya_marked_country value = yes }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_get_TAG_choosen value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_country_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

sakuya_selector_culture_select_abau_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:abau_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_abau_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:abau_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:abau_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_abau_culture = {

sakuya_selector_culture_select_amdowa_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:amdowa_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

sakuya_selector_culture_select_baraba_baraba_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:baraba_baraba_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:bena_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_bena_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:bena_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_select_bena_lwalwa = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:bena_lwalwa = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_bena_lwalwa = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:bena_lwalwa = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:bena_lwalwa = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}

		}

	is_valid = { culture:dhofari_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:dhofari_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:eyak_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_eyak_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:eyak_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:eyak_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_eyak_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:eyak_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_eyak_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:eyak_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}

sakuya_selector_culture_select_gresi_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:gresi_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { culture:guaribes_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }

		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:guaribes_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:gunbalang_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_gunbalang_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:gunbalang_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:gunbalang_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_gunbalang_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:gunbalang_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_gunbalang_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:gunbalang_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:hmong_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:hmong_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_hmong_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:hmong_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_hmong_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:hmong_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_select_ho_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:ho_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:kamoro_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_select_kanaka_maoli_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:kanaka_maoli_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_kanaka_maoli_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:kanaka_maoli_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:kanaka_maoli_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_kanaka_maoli_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:kanaka_maoli_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:kaskinampo_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:kaskinampo_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_kaskinampo_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:kaskinampo_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_kaskinampo_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:kaskinampo_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_select_katapas_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:katapas_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { culture:kono_cul = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:kono_cul = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:mizrahi = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:mono_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:mubami_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:pacahuara_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:pacahuara_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_pacahuara_culture = {

	effect = { }

	effect = { }

sakuya_selector_culture_select_paici_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:paici_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}

			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:teimani = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_teimani = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:teimani)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_select_teke = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:teke = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_teke = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:teke = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:teke = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:tionontate_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_tionontate_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:tionontate_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_select_tiou_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:tiou_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_tiou_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:tiou_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:tiou_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { culture:tolomako_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:tolomako_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:umboi_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_umboi_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:umboi_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:umboi_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_umboi_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:umboi_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_umboi_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:umboi_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:votian)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_select_wa_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:wa_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_wa_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:wa_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:wa_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_wa_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:wa_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}

	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:wetarese_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:worla_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_worla_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:worla_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_select_wu_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:wu_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_clear_wu_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:wu_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:wu_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:yongzhou_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		culture:yongzhou_culture = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_culture_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_culture_check_yongzhou_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { culture:yongzhou_culture = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_present_yongzhou_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "culture_percentage_in_country(culture:yongzhou_culture)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_culture_select_yorta_yorta_culture = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		culture:yorta_yorta_culture = {
			every_culture = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_culture } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_culture }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_culture value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_culture_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

		save_scope_as = player_country

		religion:bon = {
			every_religion = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_religion } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_religion }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_religion value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_religion_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { religion:irritila_religion = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_religion } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		religion:irritila_religion = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_religion
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_religion_scope }
		}
	}
}

		save_scope_as = player_country

		religion:palaung_religion = {
			every_religion = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_religion } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_religion }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_religion value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_religion_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		religion:romuva = {
			every_religion = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_religion } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_religion }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_religion value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_religion_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}

	is_valid = { religion:tibetan_buddhism = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_religion } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		religion:tibetan_buddhism = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_religion
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_religion_scope }
		}
	}
}

	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		religion:tiwa_religion = {
			every_religion = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_religion } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_religion }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_religion value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_religion_scope value = root } }
		}
	}

	is_valid = { religion:yukaghir_shamanism = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_religion } }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country
		religion:yukaghir_shamanism = {
			remove_variable = sakuya_selected_religion
			scope:player_country = { remove_variable = sakuya_selector_religion_scope }
		}
	}
}
sakuya_selector_religion_check_yukaghir_shamanism = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { religion:yukaghir_shamanism = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_religion } }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_religion_present_yukaghir_shamanism = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { "religion_percentage_in_country(religion:yukaghir_shamanism)" > 0 }
	effect = { }
}
sakuya_selector_religion_select_yuman_religion = {
	scope = country
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	effect = {
		save_scope_as = player_country

		religion:yuman_religion = {
			every_religion = { limit = { has_variable = sakuya_selected_religion } remove_variable = sakuya_selected_religion }
			set_variable = { name = sakuya_selected_religion value = yes }
			scope:player_country = { set_variable = { name = sakuya_selector_religion_scope value = root } }
		}
	}
}
